Northern Illinois is 128th in the FBS with a -8 turnover margin, compared to North Dakota State's 6th-ranked +10 margin. Northern Illinois lost 28-7 to Nevada on Nov. 14. Dickens threw for 194 yards on 21-of-35 attempts (60.0%) with one touchdown and one interception. Johnson had 31 rushing yards on 11 carries, adding three receptions for 15 yards. La'Don Bryant recorded 68 yards on four catches. Next game North Dakota State plays at San Jose State on Nov. 27.
